title: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowes
question:
List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Female means gender = 'F'; A11 refers to average salary; Gap = highest average salary - lowest average salary; If the person A's birthdate > B's birthdate, it means that person B is order than person A.

prediction.sql:
WITH female_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001 AS account_number, c.XCL_011 AS birth_date, d.XCL_027 AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d1 ON c.XCL_009 = d1.XCL_014
    JOIN account a ON d1.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
),
min_birth AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_bd FROM female_accounts
),
min_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS min_sal FROM female_accounts
),
max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary) AS max_sal FROM female_accounts
)
SELECT fa.account_number, (ms.max_sal - fa.avg_salary) AS gap
FROM female_accounts fa
CROSS JOIN min_birth mb
CROSS JOIN min_salary mn
CROSS JOIN max_salary ms
WHERE fa.birth_date = mb.min_bd
  AND fa.avg_salary = mn.min_sal;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001 AS account_number,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.XCL_027) FROM district d2) - d.XCL_027 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d1 ON d1.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN account a ON a.XCL_001 = d1.XCL_015
JOIN district d ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC, d.XCL_027 ASC
LIMIT 1;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    a.XCL_001 AS account_number,
    (SELECT MAX(avg_salary) FROM (
        SELECT AVG(d.XCL_026) AS avg_salary
        FROM client c
        JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
        WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    )) - (SELECT MIN(avg_salary) FROM (
        SELECT AVG(d.XCL_026) AS avg_salary
        FROM client c
        JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
        WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    )) AS salary_gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district di ON c.XCL_012 = di.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
GROUP BY a.XCL_001
HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_009) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(c2.XCL_009) AS cnt
        FROM client c2
        JOIN disp d2 ON c2.XCL_009 = d2.XCL_014
        JOIN account a2 ON d2.XCL_015 = a2.XCL_001
        WHERE c2.XCL_010 = 'F'
        GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    )
)
AND AVG(di.XCL_026) = (
    SELECT MIN(avg_sal)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(di2.XCL_026) AS avg_sal
        FROM client c2
        JOIN disp d2 ON c2.XCL_009 = d2.XCL_014
        JOIN account a2 ON d2.XCL_015 = a2.XCL_001
        JOIN district di2 ON c2.XCL_012 = di2.XCL_017
        WHERE c2.XCL_010 = 'F'
        GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    )
)
